Results.ReviewText: We purchased the two burner BBQ since we discovered that a 3 burner was unnecessary for the quantity of food we cook for the family. What drew us to the "Spirit" was the two sided grate system which has been very nice to create appeals dark lines on stake and burgers. The grates are easy to clean as we also purchased the brush specifically made for the grates which has made cleaning a breeze. We also liked the propane tank volume measurement system which hangs the bottle and lets us know the volume left within the tank. We also like the foldable side tables which is great for holding food/plates/utensils while cooking.
Results.Title: Great BBQ for Families

Results.ReviewText: Easy to start. Easy to use. Cooks well. Looks good too.

Results.ReviewText: Assembly was easy, all the hardware was included, directions were simple and precise, and amazingly all the holes lined up perfectly. Lights quickly and heats fast. Perfect size for us.

Results.ReviewText: This is a perfect size our use.  It is easy to operate and maintain. My previous grill was a Weber Gas grill which lasted many, many years. I expect this one to do the same.
Results.Title: New Weber Spirit E-210 Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText:
We bought the Weber Spirit BBQ last spring for Father’s Day and have used the Weber BBQ at the cottage maybe 8 times last summer, stored the BBQ for winter and used it once this year. In the spring, we noticed two of the bars are rusted already! We called Weber and told them two of the bars were rusted and was told they were guaranteed. We were expecting them to send us three bars as promised. We sent then the photos as requested and they never even acknowledged receipt. We waited two weeks for those bars to arrive. We had to write them again to follow up. We told everyone what a good product and guarantee Weber had. Now we will have to renegade.

Here’s their reply:

Thank you for following up with the pictures requested, shamefully after reviewing them, we can see that they're not replaceable at this moment since they don't have holes or cracks on them.

I am assuming that by next summer, there will actually be holes in the bars but the guarantee will here expired.
Results.Title: Rusted bars

Key to grills is cleaning and upkeep!  Love Weber!

Results.ReviewText:
I will never buy a Weber grill again. I waited years to buy one. My grill is only 3 years old.
This year we took it out and the wheel fell off, the other wheels look rusty also. This grill does not stay out in winter. Your people did try to help, we had to rig something up. We are just done with your brand.

Results.ReviewText: This model is not the largest grill Weber makes, but it certainly serves my purpose. It has plenty of room for several steaks/hamburgers etc.  It heats up quickly to sear meats but has a rack to take the items off of the direct fire.  It's easy to clean and the side panels fold down.  It has 4 wheels which make it easy to move around.  I certainly would recommend it to anyone!
Results.Title: Great little grill

Results.ReviewText:
Absolutely, by far, this is an excellent little bbq with fantastic results! We purchased the Weber rotisserie attachment and the first time I used it,or the bbq, I got AMAZING RESULTS!! So good, so juicy mmm 
 I didn’t give this bbq a 5 star because we purchased the bbq, got it home, almost completely assembled it and the door had a huge dent at the top and bottom of the door… I phone the store immediately and after talking to a few people we opt to load it in the truck with the door and return it the next day. 
We grabbed another bbq and assembled another bbq and don’t you know it! The back is only half covered now as opposed to the first bbq had a full coverage back. That being said, we live in a windy area and if it is a windy day, I will avoid using it because it goes out….
Results.Title: Love my spirit e210!!

Results.ReviewText: Very nice, should have back fully closed, not 1/3. Handle should be metal.

Results.Title: Grates

Results.ReviewText: Solid BBQ. Openings in the grill could be smaller. You have to really think about it if grilling smaller foods.
Results.Title: Solid BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Have really been impressed with this little Weber.  Had Weber charcoal grills and portables for years, without issue, this was my first foray into a full size Weber gas grill.  Assembly of the grill was flawless, all parts went together quickly and easily.  Fired up instantly.  Have used it for around two months now, quickly reached temperature, cooks evenly and is easy to clean.  The drip tray and pan make removing grease and spills very simple. I would recommend this grill highly especially over others in this price range.
Results.Title: Great Little Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: The grill is great.  This is a replacement grill for the same model that we had for over 20 years.  In the future, it would be helpful to include the bulk propane connection kit with the grill for customers who need it. It was a hassle to have a delay in using it and to find out that we had to pay extra for a new kit since the old Weber grill kit we had did not fit this same model.  I’m not sure why you changed the connection, but if you are going to do that, it would be helpful to include the kit with the grill as a standard feature.
Results.Title: Great grill, but needs to include bulk propane kit

Results.ReviewText: Good grill bought it assembled from Ace Hardware. Takes for ever to heat up to 400 degrees F.
Results.Title: Grill came assembled.

Results.ReviewText: Best grill I’ve ever owned.  Worth the few extra dollars for far better quality.

Results.ReviewText: Have only used a few times, since we only recently purchased it, and while it appears to work well, many of the materials seem more cheaply-made than the older model we had, such as the metal grill grates themselves, and the minimal back panel behind the tank is disturbing.  Other design changes such as the folding side shelves are welcome, but the reversed direction of the flavor bars makes me wonder.
Results.Title: Design changes to Spirit Gas Grill

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
